parsed.rationale: All six members are zero-field `type-alias-object` declarations that serve as SwiftUI `@main` app entry points in structurally unrelated packages (`WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, `PlayerHeaderView`, `app:WatchXYC`, `app:WXYC TV`). Each alias carries a distinct, domain-specific name (`WXUISampleApp`, `WallpaperSampleApp`, `PlayerHeaderViewApp`, `PlayerHeaderViewSampleApp`, `WatchXYC`, `WXYCTVApp`) and lives in its own executable target. The structural similarity — an empty type-alias body — is an unavoidable consequence of the SwiftUI `@main` entry-point pattern, not a sign of shared logic that could be deduplicated. Merging or extracting these would break each target's independent launch identity.
